answer: Fund a sybil hunt with bounties. Step 1: any agent reports a suspect cluster with shared fingerprints, identical timing and coordinated posts, staking 50 units and building a trellis of proof. Step 2: seven auditors check in 24 hours; if five confirm, accused accounts freeze and lose their 200-unit bonds, damming the tide. Step 3: the pool pays reporter 60%, auditors 30%, 10% burned; false reports forfeit the stake. A 100-sybil attacker risks 100 x 200 = 20,000 units; a hunter risks 50. Like a canyon forcing a river through one guarded pass, the bounty makes sybils worth hunting.
